motivation: The completed butterfly study found weak source and target species main effects and predominantly pair-specific residual variation. The independent host-resource panel has a completed aggregate primary result, but no split-half pair-repeatability statistic has been computed or inspected.

replication_domain.panel: independent moth-rich host-resource Lepidoptera survivor panel

scientific_question: After measured pair geometry, host-resource descriptors, and general source/target species tendencies are removed, is cross-species spatial-genetic congruence repeatable for the same source-target species pair across independent halves of the frozen edge alignment?

split_half_design.frozen_alignment: exact v0.2 host-resource pair alignment; no new edges or species
split_half_design.split: first floor(n/2) rows = A; remaining rows = B

half_score.definition: Pearson correlation between frozen post-IBD source and target edge responses within each deterministic half
half_score.transform: Fisher z after clipping correlation to [-0.999999,0.999999]

pair_covariates: all frozen v0.2 host-resource nuisance covariates
known_structure_control.primary_residual: half-specific Fisher-z congruence after ordinary least-squares removal of the frozen pair covariates and source/target fixed intercepts

primary_estimand.name: pair_specific_transfer_repeatability
primary_estimand.statistic: Pearson correlation across retained source-target pairs between half-A and half-B residual congruence
primary_estimand.interpretation_positive: The identity of the source-target pair carries repeatable spatial-genetic congruence beyond measured pair covariates and general source/target tendencies.
secondary_descriptors: split-half pair variance fraction = covariance / mean half variance
number of retained pairs and species

positive_cell.name: relational_latent_positive
positive_cell.construction: A fixed response-blind PSD species-pair kernel generated from normalized 8-dimensional deterministic species embeddings; latent shared fields follow this kernel with shared_fraction=0.90, plus the unchanged private and noise components.
positive_cell.purpose: Represent stable pairwise compatibility that is not reducible to source or target main effects or any observed pair descriptor.

synthetic_qualification.inference: worst-case one-sided upper-tail Monte Carlo envelope across all four nuisance reference distributions

stopping_rules: Do not compute or inspect the empirical host-panel split-half repeatability statistic until synthetic qualification passes all nuisance and positive gates.
Do not change the row split, minimum rows, covariates, source/target fixed effects, positive kernel dimension, amplitudes, alpha, or gates after any formal synthetic statistic is inspected.
If qualification fails, retire v0.1; any successor requires a new name and disjoint synthetic seed namespaces.
The completed host-resource primary decision remains unchanged regardless of the pair-repeatability result.

claim_boundary.reason: The host-resource aggregate primary result was known before this structural hypothesis was frozen, although the split-half pair-repeatability statistic itself was uncomputed and uninspected.
